# About you

You are training for the Riverside 10K on Sunday 8 November and want to break 45 minutes; your best is 46:40 from last spring. You run five days a week: easy on Monday, a Threshold session on Tuesday, Intervals on Thursday, parkrun or an easy run on Saturday and a longer easy run on Sunday. Wednesday and Friday are rest days. Your 5K best is 21:55 at parkrun. No injuries.
